acceptanceCriteria: The provider is off by default, installs no daemon, and its output is labelled external with the provider version and query digest.
Hop expansion is bounded and each row names the hop origin; provider absence degrades to the current packet visibly.
Measured on the frozen retrieval evaluation and the provider conformance tests pass.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: only reverse-import expansion exists; there is no call-graph or definition/reference expansion. Add an optional local LSP evidence provider (gopls first) supplying 1–2 hop definition/reference expansion as external evidence with its own authority and freshness, never as project authority. Prior art: LocAgent; RPG-Encoder arXiv 2602.02084. Owning specs: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md, the external evidence provider contract.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #98 (decision 0371, TCP-V0-043..046, EEP-V0-023..026), integrated via PR #100: gopls definition/reference expansion under `CORVINT_CONTEXT_LSP=gopls`, off by default, no daemon, output labelled `external` with provider version and query digest (AC1); hop expansion bounded with the hop origin in each row and visible degradation when the provider is absent (AC2); frozen bench context arm, --max-samples 20 per v2 subset, off vs on: rankings identical in 100/100 samples and recall unchanged; provider conformance tests pass (AC3). Stays experimental. NOT_RUN: full-subset bench, paired agent trial, other language servers. NOT_PRODUCED: owner acceptance and promotion. NOT_RUN: `make gate` locally (owner policy; PR #100 CI is the repository-wide gate).

title: context: import and call-graph expansion through a local LSP provider
